# netactuate_transport_service (Data Source)

Reads a Transport Service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_transport_service" "example" {
  service_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (Number) Transport service ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `service` (List of Object) Service returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service))

<a id="nestedatt--service"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `raw_json` (String)
- `service_id` (Number)
